source='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    one = next((r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == 1)
    two = next((r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == 2)
    dr, dc = two[0] - one[0], two[1] - one[1]
    sr = (dr > 0) - (dr < 0)
    sc = (dc > 0) - (dc < 0)
    ar, ac = abs(dr), abs(dc)

    def mark():
        if out[r][c] == 0:

        diagonal = ac
        for _ in range(max(0, diagonal - 1)):
            r += sr
            c += sc

            mark()
        # The last diagonal step reaches the 2 marker.

                r += sr
                c += sc
                mark()
            r += sr
            mark()
            for _ in range(ac - diagonal):
                c += sc
                mark()

'''
